title: AppearanceDef

name.description: Display name of the gender option, e.g. "Male".

body_model_asset_key.description: Body model (model.*) of this gender. Its rig decides which faces and hairstyles fit.

id.description: Face id, face.<name>; unique in the file.

model_asset_key.description: Head model (model.*); same rig as the gender's body, or a rig-less model attached at head.

items.description: A face variant: a head model that fits the gender's rig.

id.description: Hairstyle id, hair.<name>; unique in the file.

model_asset_key.description: Hair model (model.*); same rig as the gender's body, or a rig-less model attached at head.

items.description: A hairstyle: a model attached at the head attach point.

hairstyles.description: Hairstyles (hair.*), attached at the head attach point.

default.description: The face and hairstyle a new character of this gender starts with.

additionalProperties.description: What one gender offers at creation: its body, its faces and hairstyles, and the starting look.

genders.description: Options per gender. Keys are Genders terms; every term must be present.

id.description: Id, skin.<name> or haircolor.<name> by palette; unique in the file.

items.description: A palette entry: a named colour (a skin tone or a hair colour).

skin_tones.description: Skin tone palette (skin.*). Applied as a colour on the body's single material.

default_skin_tone_id.description: Skin tone (skin.*) a new character starts with.

hair_colors.description: Hair colour palette (haircolor.*). Applied as a colour on the hair material.

default_hair_color_id.description: Hair colour (haircolor.*) a new character starts with.

description: The root of content/appearance.yaml: the options offered at character creation (ARCHITECTURE §7.5.1). A single set per game, so it has no id. Cosmetic only: nothing here has a stat, rule or balance effect. Per gender it lists the body, faces and hairstyles; skin tones and hair colours are palettes shared by both genders.
